Comparable two-beds nearby. Four of the five sold between $1,028,000 and $1,150,000.

The appraisal is where the evidence sits. It is not where we aim.If we take 508 to market, the goal is the highest price a buyer will pay, not a result inside this range. 904/14 Ella reached $1,188,000 and 908 reached $1,149,999. The range tells us what the market has already paid. The final price comes from competition.

THE AIMThe highest price, not the range

The range is the floor of our thinking, not a target. Every offer is measured against the best result we can get, not against the appraisal.

HOW PRICE GOES UPBuyers competing at the same time

The strongest prices come when several qualified buyers want the same apartment at once. My job is to bring them together, then negotiate them against each other.

YOUR DECISIONYou decide when the price is right

Nothing is accepted without your agreement. You see every offer and every counter-offer, and the decision to sell stays with you.

The market now

03

Brisbane has eased since May.

Brisbane units are still up 13.2% on a year ago, but values have eased since the May peak and fewer homes are selling. Buyers are more selective, and they compare every listing.
